statement: Exponential semidefinite complexity of perfect matching. Proves that every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size, answering Rothvoss's polynomial-size lift question negatively. The bound holds even for the positive semidefinite rank of its odd-cut slack matrix after any fixed shift $`0\lt \rho\lt 1`$, allowing arbitrary real positive semidefinite factors.
